mer_a_spirit.name: Spirit Rover (MER-A)
mer_a_spirit.diagnostic_hint: Main solar bus is choked by Martian regolith. Bypass the solar array and mount the auxiliary flash drive.

puzzle_steps.output: Solar bus bypassed. Drawing residual trickle charge from thermal survival heaters...
Flash memory subsystem mounted at /mnt/spirit_archive. 1 file recovered.
Decrypting APXS & Mini-TES spectrometer telemetry... DATA RECOVERY COMPLETE.

science_payload.headline: Ancient Hot Springs & Pure Silica
science_payload.story: After its right-front wheel broke in 2006, Spirit dragged it like a plow—accidentally scraping away top soil to reveal 90% pure silica. This proved ancient Mars once had hydrothermal hot springs or steam vents, key ingredients for microbial life.

mer_b_opportunity.name: Opportunity Rover (MER-B)
mer_b_opportunity.diagnostic_hint: A planet-wide 2018 dust storm plunged power to 22 Watt-hours. Clear the fault flag and switch memory to RAM-only mode.

puzzle_steps.output: 2018 dust-storm hibernation flag cleared. Core processor online.
Worn flash memory bypassed. Operating in volatile RAM-only mode.
Downloading Microscopic Imager scans... DATA RECOVERY COMPLETE.

science_payload.headline: Martian 'Blueberries' & Standing Water
science_payload.story: Opportunity drove over 28 miles—more than a full marathon—and discovered tiny iron-rich spheres nicknamed 'blueberries' embedded in rock outcrops. These hematite concretions form when mineral-rich groundwater soaks through porous rock.

viking_1_lander.name: Viking 1 Lander
viking_1_lander.diagnostic_hint: A faulty software update in 1982 pointed the high-gain antenna away from Earth. Realign the dish and dump the RTG telemetry.

puzzle_steps.output: High-gain S-band dish gimbaled back to Earth coordinates. Carrier lock established.
Plutonium-238 Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generators reading nominal.
Reconstructing 1976 slow-scan facsimile surface panorama... DATA RECOVERY COMPLETE.

science_payload.headline: First Successful Touchdown & Rusty Soil
science_payload.story: Landing on July 20, 1976—seven years to the day after Apollo 11—Viking 1 transmitted the first clear color photographs from the surface of Mars and revealed that the planet's iconic red hue comes from iron-oxide-rich dust.

voyager_1.name: Voyager 1
voyager_1.fact: Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 is the farthest human-made object in existence—reaching 1 full light-day away from Earth in November 2026. It carries the Golden Record, a 12-inch gold-plated copper disk containing sounds and images of life on Earth.

pioneer_10.name: Pioneer 10
pioneer_10.fact: Pioneer 10 was the first spacecraft to cross the asteroid belt and capture close-up images of Jupiter. Though its nuclear power source faded in 2003, it continues coasting silently into deep space carrying a gold-anodized aluminum plaque depicting humanity.
